reader_notes: Reads as an authentic Swedish debattartikel: first-person recantation by a named board member ('Nu vill jag ta tillbaka min röst'), a declared conflict of interest ('Föreningen skulle dessutom ersättas för tillsynen, vilket borde ha gjort mig misstänksam mot min egen entusiasm'), a concession paragraph, a concrete counter-proposal ('Köp bojarna ... över driftsbudgeten'), and an anecdotal closing image. Register, idiom and vocabulary (oavkortat, remissvar, stridsfråga, landfästet, trallen, uppställningsrutor, tömningsstation, betalningsgrad om 31 procent, kastlina) are all correct and native-sounding; no calques or agreement errors spotted.
Arithmetic checks out: 4 800 betalda bad x 20 kr = 96 000 kr, correctly described as 'knappt hundratusen kronor per säsong'.

The argument is quantitatively coherent even though the text never spells the sum out: at the ställplats payment rate of 31 percent the brygga would yield ca 29 800 kr against 61 000 kr in equipment plus 9 000 kr annual tillsyn, so the 'sign-and-code' precedent really does undercut the förvaltning's calculation. Good that the reader can do this step without being led by the hand.

Incident distribution is internally consistent with the closing anecdote: 11 of 14 tillbud (79 percent) at Stångklippan, and 18 of 21 bathers counted (86 percent) up on the cliff. The self-limiting caveat ('Badvärdarna för visserligen dagbok bara under skolloven') is a realistic debate move and does not undermine the claim.

q:1 is a clean attitude/main-thesis question. D is the only option that holds both halves of the author's position ('Att åtgärder behövs är ingen stridsfråga' plus the fee objection). B is refuted by the cut line and the ladder ending half a metre above the water; C is the position she explicitly recants; A (higher fee) is nowhere in the text.

q:2 requires one genuine inference step, 31 percent paid -> ca 69 percent unpaid -> 'sju av tio nätter obetalda'. The rounding is honest (69 rounds to 7 of 10) and B/C/D are all cleanly excluded: the kommun's uppföljning did measure the rate, so B is false; C inverts it; D is unsupported.

Minor, sub-blocker observation: the förvaltning's calculation implies a surplus (96 000 kr revenue vs 61 000 + 9 000 kr cost) that the author never comments on, even though a real debater might have seized on it. It does not contradict anything she writes and municipal calculations routinely carry margin, so it reads as ordinary looseness rather than a seam.

Second minor observation: 'Linan var hel fram till i somras, och vem som kapade den vet ingen' is texture that no question uses. That is normal for authentic HP passages and did not feel like a planted distractor while reading.

Small internal detail I checked for a seam and did not find one: season cards at 200 kr coexist with a calculation expressed purely in 'betalda bad', but 4 800 x 20 still lands exactly on the stated figure, so nothing fails to reconcile.

Place names (Vässlingsbadet, Stångklippan), the byline name (Bengta Ödgren) and the distances/prices (2,3 km to nearest hjärtstartare, 61 000 kr for two buoys, a ladder and a defibrillator in värmeskåp) are all plausible for a small Swedish kommun. Nothing read as a wrong-feeling fact.
